thread:
maria: Heads-up — Arcadia Health POC asks landed. They need SSO (SAML SP), SCIM provisioning, RBAC role sync, domain verification and a filled security questionnaire by EOD Friday. Also asking for a short POC pricing estimate.

raj: Ack. For domain verification do they prefer TXT or CNAME? SCIM volume?

maria: They said TXT is fine. SCIM: initial sync ~8k users, daily delta ~500. They want role-to-group mapping for RBAC.

devin: For POC I recommend: 2-week Dedicated POC pool (reserved GPUs) + hosted control plane. That lets them validate latency and RBAC behavior. Rough estimate: equivalent to ~$4k for the 2 weeks (capacity + support). Can tighten after we confirm model/config.

sophia: Security checklist notes: we can provide SOC2 Type II report and pen test summary. For SAML we need to share ACS URL, EntityID and cert fingerprint; customer requires cert rotation policy (we rotate every 90 days by default — we can support custom cadence). For audit/logs retention they want 1y — our platform supports configurable retention up to 13 months (enterprise plan).

raj: Domain verification sample TXT we give them:

```
_redwood-verify.acme-health.com  TXT  "redwood=arcadia-verify-7f3b"
```
Set TTL 300. Once DNS record present we return verification within ~5 minutes.

maria: Can you drop the exact SAML values to send to their IdP team?

devin: SAML values (use in IdP config):

- ACS (SP Assertion Consumer Service): https://redwood.app/saml/acs/arcadia-health
- EntityID (SP): https://redwood.app/saml/metadata/arcadia-health
- Signature algorithm: RSA-SHA256
- Cert fingerprint (SHA256): 3A:9F:AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF:11:22:33:44:55:66:77:88:99:00:AA:BB:CC:4C (we'll attach full cert in the QA doc)

Also SCIM endpoints: POST/PUT to https://api.redwood.app/scim/v2/Users with OAuth bearer token. Rate guidance: soft-limit 200 req/min, bulk sync recommended via batched PATCH semantics.

raj: Quick SCIM example curl they can use for testing: 

```
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.app/scim/v2/Users" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <POC_TOKEN>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"userName":"jdoe@acme.com","name":{"givenName":"John","familyName":"Doe"}}'
```
Keep requests under the soft rate limit during initial sync; we can enable short burst allowance during bulk imports.

sophia: RBAC mapping guidance: we support mapping SAML group claims -> roles, and SCIM group provisioning. Recommended minimal roles for POC: viewer, editor, admin. We'll provide a sample mapping file and an audit log export for all role changes.

maria: Customer also wants pricing carve-outs: are we able to offer reduced POC invoice if they commit to Dedicated contract after?

devin: Yes — we can provide a credit against first month of Dedicated if they sign within 30 days. I'll draft a simple POC commercial term: 50% credit up to the POC invoice value applied to first committed month.

sophia: Action items for the QA: I'll own the security questionnaire answers (SOC2, data residency, cert rotation, KMS integration). @devin please attach the POC commercial blurb. @raj please include DNS TXT template and SCIM sample payloads.

deploy-bot: Created ticket POC-12345 for Arcadia Health (assignee: devin).

maria: Great — I'll loop in the customer's IdP engineer and legal. Target: send SAML metadata, DNS TXT, SCIM samples and draft commercial by EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:

raj: Will post SCIM attribute mapping doc to the ticket in 1hr.

devin: Draft commercial uploaded to POC-12345.

sophia: I'll upload QA answers and SOC2 AOC to the ticket after redaction checks.

maria: Thanks team — ping if any blocker.
